decisive_items: Recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope.
The rhythm strip demonstrated gradual slowing of the sinus rate and atrioventricular conduction followed by complete atrioventricular block.
Electrophysiologic studies: Showed no abnormalities in the cardiac conduction system.
response.rationale: Progressive sinus slowing, PR/PP prolongation, and complete AV block leading to a prolonged ventricular asystole in a structurally normal heart with normal EP studies are characteristic of cardioinhibitory vasovagal syncope, rather than intrinsic sinus or AV conduction disease.

rejected.why: The complete AV block is transient and part of the vagally mediated syncopal event; normal EP and normal cardiac structure argue against an intrinsic isolated AV block.
